title: Portobello Pizzas
steps: Place mushrooms stalk-up on a baking tray; trim stalks. Spray with cooking spray; season. Bake 10 minutes.
Tip out excess liquid from mushrooms.
Spread 1 tsp tomato purée in each. Sprinkle garlic granules, then divide cheese equally between them.
Top each with a quartered cherry tomato and sprinkle with oregano.
Bake another 10 minutes until cheese is melted and golden. Serve with rocket salad.
notes: Make-ahead Marinara Sauce is a great swap for tomato purée. Add any pizza toppings you like.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
